name: Importador legacy exige política y mapeo confirmado antes de escribir
description: Un administrador abre el importador y comprueba que la interfaz explica las políticas de membresía y mantiene bloqueada la importación hasta confirmar una vista previa válida.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the administrative users page with an authenticated administrator session
Open the massive Excel or CSV import dialog

Verify the import dialog presents the strict policy and the legacy report policy with clear explanations, and the final import action remains disabled before a file preview and mapping confirmation exist
Verify the dialog is arranged as a readable vertical workflow on mobile and desktop, with the file area above the membership, mapping, preview, and final action stages
